name: Embraer EMB-110 Bandeirante
summary: Brazil's first big commercial hit, a 15- to 21-seat low-wing twin turboprop commuter and freighter with PT6A engines.

engines: Two PT6A turboprops on the wing, mounted well forward
fuselage: Long, slim, round fuselage with a rounded nose
Small oval windows along the length
Rear left door, often with a cargo door on freighters

tellTales: Slim low-wing twin turboprop with a rounded nose and small oval windows
Three-blade props on nacelles reaching well ahead of the wing
Conventional tail with a tall fin

confusedWith.howToTell: The Metro has a sharply pointed 'shark' nose and a slimmer fuselage; the Bandeirante has a more rounded nose and a deeper cabin.
The 1900 has a T-tail with small fins on the tail cone; the Bandeirante has a conventional low tail.
The Dornier 228 is a high-wing aircraft with a boxy fuselage; the Bandeirante is a low-wing with a round fuselage.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
